changes.title: Rainbow ley
items: The ley line is a row of rainbow dots, its colours drifting toward its tip, its spark is bigger, and behind the spark the whole way home it's the music's analyser
Clearing a soundsystem early sends the rainbow wave both ways from that soundsystem, twice as fast and three times as long, the way back stopping at the spark

changes.title: Legend crown
items: Every legend's sigil wears a crown, in the sigil's own colour
A sleeping legend's sigil is purple, like a baby's: neutral until it wakes
Legend pointers are just the crowned sigil and its arrow, with no ring round them
The music pointer's countdown ring: the part still to fill is a dark grey track, so the filled part reads at a glance

changes.title: Pad swap
items: On a gamepad, □ now uses and places (stations, sigils, runes) and ✕ takes off and lands; in menus ✕ still chooses and ○ goes back
